# Regions property for a Billboard.js chart

Add a shading effect to the background of the chart, to highlight a
period for example.

## Usage

``` r
bb_regions(bb, ...)
```

## Arguments

- bb:

  A \`billboard\` \`htmlwidget\` object.

- ...:

  See
  \<https://naver.github.io/billboard.js/release/latest/doc/Options.html#.regions\>

## Value

A \`billboard\` \`htmlwidget\` object.

## Note

This function can be used with \[billboarderProxy()\] in Shiny
applications.

## See also

\[bb_add_style()\]

## Examples

``` r
# With a categorical X-axis
dat <- data.frame(
  month = month.abb,
  AirPassengers = tail(AirPassengers, 12)
)
# Highlight Jun/Jul/Aug
billboarder() %>%
  bb_linechart(data = dat, x = "month") %>%
  bb_x_axis(type = "category") %>%
  bb_regions(
    list(start = 4.5, end = 7.5) # jan = 0
  )

  
  

{"x":{"bb_opts":{"interaction":{"inputType":{"touch":false}},"line":{"classes":["billboarder-line-AirPassengers"]},"data":{"x":"month","json":{"month":["Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun","Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec"],"AirPassengers":[417,391,419,461,472,535,622,606,508,461,390,432]},"types":{"AirPassengers":"line"},"x.1":"month"},"point":{"show":false},"axis":{"x":{"type":"category"}},"regions":[{"start":4.5,"end":7.5}]},"data":null},"evals":[],"jsHooks":[]}
# With a barchart
billboarder() %>%
  bb_barchart(data = dat) %>%
  bb_regions(
    list(start = 1.5, end = 2.5, class = "custom"),
    list(start = 8, end = 10, class = "foo")
  ) %>%
  bb_add_style(region = list(custom = "fill: red;", foo = "fill: #009246;"))

  
  

{"x":{"bb_opts":{"interaction":{"inputType":{"touch":false}},"data":{"x":"bb-x","json":{"bb-x":["Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun","Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec"],"AirPassengers":[417,391,419,461,472,535,622,606,508,461,390,432]},"type":"bar"},"bar":[],"axis":{"x":{"type":"category"},"rotated":false},"regions":[{"start":1.5,"end":2.5,"class":"custom"},{"start":8,"end":10,"class":"foo"}],"customStyle":[".bb-region.custom{fill: red;}.bb-region.foo{fill: #009246;}"]},"data":null},"evals":[],"jsHooks":[]}
# With Date X-axis
library("stats")
dat <- data.frame(
  date = seq.Date(from = Sys.Date(), by = "day", length.out = 365),
  var = density(rexp(n = 1000), n = 365)$y
)

billboarder() %>%
  bb_linechart(data = dat) %>%
  bb_x_axis(tick = list(fit = FALSE)) %>%
  bb_y_axis(min = 0, padding = 0) %>%
  bb_regions(
    list(start = format(Sys.Date() + 30), end = format(Sys.Date() + 120))
  )

# With POSIXct X-axis
dat <- data.frame(
  time = seq.POSIXt(from = Sys.time(), by = "min", length.out = 60),
  var = round(sort(rnorm(60)), 2)
)

billboarder() %>%
  bb_linechart(data = dat) %>%
  bb_x_axis(tick = list(format = "%H:%M", fit = FALSE)) %>%
  bb_regions(
    list(start = format(dat$time[15]),
         end = format(dat$time[30]))
  )
```
